mapper.update:
update voya_ai_trip_item
attraction_id = #{attractionId}, item_type = #{itemType}, title = #{title}, start_time = #{startTime}, end_time = #{endTime}, address = #{address}, description = #{description}, estimated_cost = #{estimatedCost}, sort = #{sort}, update_time = now()
where id = #{id} and del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: select i.id, i.trip_day_id as dayId, i.attraction_id as attractionId, a.name as attractionName, i.item_type as itemType, i.title, i.start_time as startTime, i.end_time as endTime, i.address, i.description, i.estimated_cost as estimatedCost, i.sort from voya_ai_trip_item i left join voya_ai_attraction a on i.attraction_id = a.id where i.trip_day_id = #{dayId} and i.del_flag = '0' order by i.sort asc, i.id asc
